request.spec:
People can be pasted in as lines of name,grade into an import box. All the lines are checked
first, with the same rules as the form: an empty name, a grade other than A, B or C, a name
already on the sheet, or a name repeated in the paste (compared like uniqueness) is an error. If
any line has an error, nothing is imported and each bad line is marked with its line number;
otherwise every person is added, in order, each with a PERSON_ADDED line in the audit, and the
count added is shown.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
People can be pasted in as lines of name,grade into an import box. All the lines are checked
first, with the same rules as the form: an empty name, a grade other than A, B or C, a name
already on the sheet, or a name repeated in the paste (compared like uniqueness) is an error. If
any line has an error, nothing is imported and each bad line is marked with its line number;
otherwise every person is added, in order, each with a PERSON_ADDED line in the audit, and the
count added is shown.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
I've added the people import, and `bin/e2e` passes.

**Server** (`PersonService.importPeople`, plus `POST /api/sheets/{id}/people/import` in `PersonController`):
- Every line is checked before anything is written. A line is an error if its name is empty or longer than 100 characters, its grade isn't A, B or C, the name is already on the sheet (ignoring case), or the name appears earlier in the same paste (also ignoring case).
- If any line has an error, the server returns the bad line numbers with a reason for each and saves nothing, so nothing goes to the audit file either.
- Otherwise it adds everyone in order in one transaction, writing one `PERSON_ADDED sheet=… by=… name=… grade=…` line per person, and returns the count added.

**Front end** (`features/people/people.ts`, `core/people.ts`):
- The import box sits with the people form. After a submit it shows the count in `import-added`, and marks each bad line with `import-error-<n>` and its reason.
- A successful import clears the box and re-reads the list of people.
- If the request itself fails (a network or server error), an `import-error` message appears.

A few choices the request didn't settle:
- **Blank lines are skipped,** but line numbers still count them, so an error's number matches its line in the pasted text.
- **A line is split at its last comma,** so a name can contain commas (`Smith, J,A` imports "Smith, J" with grade A).
- **Spaces around the name and grade are trimmed,** but the grade is case-sensitive: `a` is an error, not A.
